title: bagua
description: A rare item mod inspired by Chinese Bagua.
body:
Why Download This Mod?
Cultural Immersion: Bring the ancient wisdom of Chinese philosophy into your Minecraft world.

Strategic Gameplay: Choose the right talisman for any situation — explore oceans with Kan, survive the Nether with Li, or take on bosses with Qian.

Collector’s Delight: Each talisman features a unique visual design and its own crafting recipe, rewarding completionists.

Before You Download
Talismans only work when placed in your main inventory or hotbar — they do not function if stored in chests, shulker boxes, or other containers.

The Crafting Template must be obtained first to craft any talisman. The advancement tree provides clear, step-by-step guidance on how to acquire it and forge all eight talismans.

Download now and let the power of the eight trigrams shape your journey.
“The great virtue of heaven and earth is called life.” — I Ching
